name: fyrst/shopware-cd
description: Thin Packagist library for fyrst.dev Shopware continuous deploy. Overlay files (CI, Compose, deploy) are served by Symfony Flex from fyrst-dev/recipes, not this package. Image builds use docker/Dockerfile from shopware/docker. Not a Shopware installation.

suggest.shopware/docker: Required. Require it on the same composer require line as fyrst/shopware-cd. Flex copies the official multi-stage Dockerfile to docker/Dockerfile. Image builds always use that file; set CI DOCKERFILE=docker/Dockerfile (or default to that).
suggest.shopware/deployment-helper: Deploy-time install/update. Require it in the shop in the same composer require as this package.
